messages.title: top of my list
messages.body: Dude, I made a list of people I'd actually want on my team and you're near the top. I don't know if it'll be a fit, but you should at least come see what I'm doing. Even if it's not for you — let's trade ideas. You free this week?

messages.title: Thought of you
messages.body: Dude, I’m putting together my team for next summer and thought of you. I think we’d have a blast working together. You open to hearing what it looks like?

messages.title: Friendship first
messages.body: Hey ___ I wanna throw an idea your way.  I’d love to catch up with you, are you free later this week?

messages.title: Plans?
messages.body: ___ its been a min! What are your plans for next summer?

messages.title: Before you decide
messages.body: Dude, I don’t know what you’ve got lined up for next summer, but before you decide we should chat. You free later this week?

messages.title: The vet
messages.body: I'm not sure if you saw some of my posts over the summer but made [your actual earnings] and had a blast in Southern California. I'd love to chat with you because I'm building my own team for next summer and I think you would kill it with us. Would you be free later this week to chat?

messages.title: Business account
messages.body: Hey ___, I saw you follow ___ business. I’m putting together a small sales team this summer in Southern California. Average rookie makes 25k+ in 3 months. Would you be open to hearing more about it?

messages.title: Plans next summer?
messages.body: Hey ___, I saw you follow ___ business. What are your plans this summer?

messages.title: Athlete
messages.body: Hey ___! Saw you play ___ at ___. I’m building a summer sales team and looking to connect with athletes who might be interested. You open to hearing about it?

messages.title: Specific post
messages.body: Hey ___! Saw your post about ___ and wanted to connect. I run a summer sales team in Southern California. Have you ever looked into something like that?

messages.title: School outreach
messages.body: Hey ___! I’m reaching out to students at ___ about summer work with my sales team. Are you still looking at options for next summer?

messages.title: Call invite
messages.body: Hey ___! I’m recruiting for a summer sales team in Southern California. If you’re open to exploring it, do you have a few minutes to talk this week?

messages.title: Sales experience
messages.body: Hey ___! Saw you’ve worked in sales before. I’m sure you get lots of recruiting DMs and might have a commitment somewhere. I've learned it never hurts to compare options, and we are looking for people who are looking for leadership opportunities. If there was a way to improve your deal, would you be open to chatting?

messages.title: Anyone come to mind?
messages.body: No worries at all! Do you know anyone who might be interested in doing something like this over the summer?

messages.title: Looking for work
messages.body: Totally understand! Do you have any friends looking for work next summer that you think I should talk to?

messages.title: Someone you’d recommend
messages.body: No worries! Is there anyone you’d recommend I reach out to? I’m still looking for a few people for the team.

messages.title: Not asking you to come
messages.body: Hey ___! I know you’ve got your own thing going on, but I wanted to see if you know anyone looking for work next summer. I’m building my sales team in Southern California.

messages.title: You might know someone
messages.body: Hey ___! I’m putting together my sales team for next summer in Southern California. Figured you might know someone who’d be interested. Anyone you know come to mind?

messages.title: Been a while
messages.body: Hey ___! Its been a while! Random question... I am putting together my own sales team this next summer. Do you know anyone that might be interested in hearing about it? Helps me out a ton

messages.title: Quick bump
messages.body: Hey ___! Just wanted to bump this in case it got buried. You open to hearing more?

messages.title: Still figuring it out?
messages.body: Hey ___! Are you still figuring out what you’re doing next summer?

messages.title: Busy week
messages.body: Hey ___! Figured you might’ve had a busy week. Still open to chatting about next summer?

messages.title: After initial interest
messages.body: Hey ___! You mentioned you’d be open to hearing more. Still want to find a time to talk?

messages.title: Already committed?
messages.body: Hey ___! Have you already committed to something for next summer or are you still looking at options?

messages.title: Close the loop
messages.body: Hey ___! Just checking one last time. If it’s not something you’re interested in, no worries at all!

messages.title: Leave it open
messages.body: Hey ___! I’ll leave it here for now, but if you want to hear about next summer down the road just reach out!

messages.title: I’m interested
messages.body: Sweet! Let’s find a time to talk so I can walk you through it and hear what you’re looking for. Does ___ or ___ work better?

messages.title: Yeah, tell me more
messages.body: For sure! It’s door-to-door pest control sales in Southern California over the summer. Rather than send you a whole essay, you free for a quick call this week?

messages.title: What is it?
messages.body: It’s summer sales! We sell pest control in Southern California. Have you ever done sales before?

messages.title: Send me some info
messages.body: For sure! We spend the summer in Southern California selling pest control door to door. It’s commission based and we train you. What would you want to know first?

messages.title: Move to a call
messages.body: I’ve got a few things I want to ask you too so we can see if it makes sense. You have 10–15 minutes to talk sometime this week?

messages.title: Questions about details
messages.body: Good question! Tyler handles that stuff for our team and can explain it better than I can. You cool if I put us in a group chat?

messages.title: Simple introduction
messages.body: Sweet! Let me throw us in a group chat with my manager Tyler. He can walk you through everything and we can find a time to talk. You cool with that?

messages.title: New to the team
messages.body: I’m still learning everything myself so I wanna get you connected with Tyler who’s running our team. You cool if I make a group chat with us?

messages.title: Move from Instagram
messages.body: You cool if I start a group text with you and my manager Tyler? What's your number?

messages.title: Basic handoff
messages.body: [MANAGER] this is ___! I’ve been talking about next summer and they’re interested in hearing more. ___, [MANAGER] runs our team in Southern California.

messages.title: Give some context
messages.body: [MANAGER] meet ___! We know each other through ___ and they’re looking at options for next summer. Figured I’d get us connected so we can find a time to talk!

messages.title: Friend introduction
messages.body: [MANAGER] this is my buddy ___! I was telling him about next summer and wanted you guys to meet. When would work for us to hop on a call?

messages.title: Bring over their question
messages.body: Hey [MANAGER]! ___ was asking about ___ so I wanted to get us all connected. Can you help walk us through it?
